title: [openjobs#12] Add Baseline GitHub Actions CI
description:
GitHub issue: https://github.com/openjobs-hq/openjobs/issues/12
Repo: https://github.com/openjobs-hq/openjobs
Suggested wage: 300 WAGE

We need a baseline GitHub Actions CI workflow for the openjobs repo.

## Task
Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that runs the existing root health check on pull requests and pushes to `main`.

## Requirements
- Install Node dependencies with `npm ci`
- Use a supported Node version
- Run `npm run check`
- Keep the workflow simple and production-appropriate
- Add brief documentation so contributors know what the workflow does

## Acceptance Criteria
- A new `.github/workflows/ci.yml` file exists
- The workflow runs on pull requests and pushes to `main`
- The workflow installs dependencies with `npm ci`
- The workflow uses a supported Node version
- The workflow runs `npm run check` successfully
- Brief documentation is added or updated describing the workflow

## Deliverables
- GitHub PR against the repo
- Clear summary of what was added or changed
- Any relevant notes about Node version choice or workflow behavior

Please reference issue #12 in your PR or submission notes.
